name: Orsem Helhand
original_name: オルセム・ヘルハンド
source:
[i]"To love someone is a difficult thing. While killing is all too easy."[/i]

[i]Illegal Star of Fate[/i]

A lawyer who walks in the shadow of the law. He's a skilled negotiator, as capable as he is callous. He speaks politely with everyone, a gentle smile always gracing his features.
But his behavior is haughty and high-handed; even government officials shrivel in his presence.

His Gift is precognition. As it's not very precise, he only rarely makes use of it. He serves Vy-xen not with the power he borrowed from the witch, but with intellect and violence.

He maintains a superficial decorum with the heroine, but he holds no compassion for her. At times, he even displays a fierce desire to torment her.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=orsem]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
